messages:
alex: Noticed invoice-preview shows ~+3% tokens for APAC tenants this morning. looks correlated with sampling rollouts last week.

renee: saw the spike too. which pipeline stage? preview vs final ledger mismatch?

alex: preview totals (billing.preview) > final tally for several tenants. digging logs suggests aggregation windows are shifting by tenant_tz when sampling is on. sampling injects `sample_ts` and our aggregator uses local hour bucket if tenant_timezone present.

diego: we intentionally added tenant_timezone to support localized dashboards but aggregation should be UTC-only for billing. who added timezone->bucket behavior?

priya: that was my change for localized usage charts (PR #4982). I didn't realize the tally consumer would prefer UTC buckets too. the consumer reads `event_bucket` header that the edge sets.

billing-bot: :information_source: alert fired: invoice-preview-vs-final delta > 2% for APAC (rule: preview-final-delta).

mark: quick root cause theory: edge sets `event_bucket_local` and `event_bucket_utc`; the sampler currently chooses `event_bucket_local` when tenant_timezone present and that value gets propagated into staging.preview.topic. aggregator later reads `event_bucket_utc` only. result: preview groups by local hour, final groups by UTC hour -> sampling mismatched spans.

alex: repro: replayed 5k sampled events with tenant_timezone=Asia/Tokyo into preview store. preview sum=1,004,500, final sum after aggregate=975,100. mismatch concentrated on buckets crossing midnight UTC.

renee: proposed fixes: (1) canonicalize bucket to `event_bucket_utc` before publishing to preview (safer), (2) change aggregator to accept both and normalize, or (3) remove timezone-driven bucketing from sampler.

priya: (1) seems lowest blast radius. we can add a sampler flag `preview_emit_utc_bucket: true`. add `agg_bucket_version` header too.

diego: also small UX ask: console preview should annotate which bucket type was used and show a toggle (UTC/local) so CS can reason about deltas.

mark: we need telemetry: emit metric `preview.bucket_mismatch_rate` and a histogram of per-tenant delta by bucket_type. add alert if mismatch rate > 0.5% for 24h.

billing-bot: :rotating_light: deploy scheduled: sampler v3.7.1 -> preview-emit-utc for 2% tenants on 2026-03-30T02:00Z.

alex: rollout plan: canary 2% APAC tenants 72h -> 10% global -> full. run offline backfill compute for last 7 days for affected tenants and tag invoices with `bucket_correction=true` if adjustment needed.

priya: will open PR with feature flag and unit tests. adding `agg_bucket_version` header as Mark suggested.

renee: ops playbook: if delta persists after canary expand, revert flag and trigger backfill+credit job. include template customer comms and billing notes.

diego: dashboard changes: add card `preview_vs_final_by_bucket` and `bucket_mismatch_suspects` list that links to raw event stream for tenant. also show `agg_bucket_version` in audit view.

mark: important: ensure ancient sampled events (archived) don't get double-corrected during backfill. add idempotency marker `bucket_backfilled_v{n}`.

priya: client impact: none. internal only. but will update docs so SAs understand preview toggle in console.

alex: timeline: PR in 24h, canary in 48h, monitor 72h. owners: priya->PR+tests, diego->dashboards+links, mark->metrics+alerts, renee->runbook+backfill script, alex->canary coordination.

billing-bot: :white_check_mark: task created: BILL-1243 backfill-run for APAC buckets.

renee: one last note: add note in console about "Preview buckets normalized to UTC to align with billing ledger" so customers know why numbers differ from localized charts.

alex: thanks everyone. will post canary results in 24h.

priya: ack, starting PR now.
